description: Local commands for using the AQLEN visual graph layout renderer.

commands.name: serve_repo_root
commands.notes: Run from the repository root so dashboard/receipt_graph_renderer.html can fetch dashboard/receipt_graph_dashboard_demo.json.

commands.name: open_renderer
commands.notes: Open in a browser, then choose Load demo export.

commands.name: export_dashboard_payload
commands.notes: Regenerates the demo dashboard payload before opening the renderer.

commands.name: graph_layout_modes
commands.command: Use the Layout dropdown: Pipeline lanes or Radial trace.
commands.notes: Pipeline is best for the whole receipt chain. Radial is best for one focused node.

commands.name: trace_only_mode
commands.command: Toggle Trace only in the renderer.
commands.notes: Hides non-trace nodes and edges for focused review.
